comments.body:
Ralf,

I pushed a fix to the top-level pom.xml in the 3.7.2-SNAPSHOT branch this morning: https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/2acb15a517955af52cb2b3e50971776ccd61e4c2

Can you pull this commit, and verify it fixes the issue?

Doesn't work as expected. Looks like SSL error disappeared but there is some other build error now.
Here is the order:

1- Attempt to resolve dependencies for https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/27a6bd183809d993e1a7640ecb5a6333263928c0 (expected result):
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal on project fcrepo-common: Could not resolve dependencies for project org.fcrepo:fcrepo-common:jar:3.7.2-SNAPSHOT: Failed to collect dependencies for [commons-codec:commons-codec:jar:1.7 (compile), org.apache.httpcomponents:httpclient:jar:4.2.5 (compile), org.apache.httpcomponents:httpmime:jar:4.2.5 (compile), javax.xml:jaxrpc-api:jar:1.1 (compile), org.fcrepo:mulgara-core:jar:2.1.13 (compile), org.jboss.security:jboss-sunxacml:jar:2.0.9.Final (compile), wsdl4j:wsdl4j:jar:1.6.2 (compile), org.slf4j:slf4j-api:jar:1.7.2 (compile), org.slf4j:log4j-over-slf4j:jar:1.7.2 (runtime), org.slf4j:jcl-over-slf4j:jar:1.7.2 (runtime), dom4j:dom4j:jar:1.6.1 (compile), org.fcrepo:saxon:jar:9.0 (compile), javax.servlet:servlet-api:jar:2.4 (provided), joda-time:joda-time:jar:1.5.2 (compile), commons-pool:commons-pool:jar:1.6 (compile), commons-io:commons-io:jar:2.4 (compile), junit:junit:jar:4.10 (test)]: Failed to read artifact descriptor for org.fcrepo:mulgara-core:jar:2.1.13: Could not transfer artifact org.fcrepo:mulgara-core:pom:2.1.13 from/to duraspace-releases (https://m2.duraspace.org/content/repositories/releases): peer not authenticated -> [Help 1]

2-Attempt to resolve dependencies for https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/2acb15a517955af52cb2b3e50971776ccd61e4c2 (new error)
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal on project fcrepo-server: Could not resolve dependencies for project org.fcrepo:fcrepo-server:jar:3.7.2-SNAPSHOT: The following artifacts could not be resolved: org.trippi:trippi-core:jar:1.5.10-SNAPSHOT, org.trippi:trippi-mptstore:jar:1.5.10-SNAPSHOT, org.trippi:trippi-mulgara:jar:1.5.10-SNAPSHOT, org.fcrepo:fcrepo-common:jar:3.7.2-SNAPSHOT, org.fcrepo:fcrepo-common:jar:tests:3.7.2-SNAPSHOT: Could not find artifact org.trippi:trippi-core:jar:1.5.10-SNAPSHOT in apache-releases (https://repository.apache.org/content/groups/public/) -> [Help 1]

Ok, looks like the reason here is the requested trippi version 1.5.10-SNAPSHOT. I get that this has been introduced to fix https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1214 with commit https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/27a6bd183809d993e1a7640ecb5a6333263928c0

After installing 1.5.10-SNAPSHOT (as Benjamin actually suggested) build to my local repository it worked.
trippi 1.5.10 is now available in the main maven repositories, and the fcrepo project poms have been updated.

I've just downloaded the 3.8.0 source snapshot from Github and something very similar is happening when I try and build with Maven. I am not a heavyweight Java person and don't have that much fedora-commons experience, so if this is something simple, apologies:
